hero.title: Smart add-on pricing
hero.lead: Automatically adjust product pricing based on customization. Add extra charges for product options, colors, print areas, clipart, sizes, and other design elements to keep pricing accurate as customers customize.

products_lead: From a simple mug to a fully customized jacket, every choice can carry its own price.

faqs.a: Instantly, as shoppers add options, colors, print areas or clipart in the editor.

faqs.q: What can I charge extra for?
faqs.a: Product options, colors, print areas, clipart, sizes and other design elements.

faqs.q: Do shoppers see the extra charges?
faqs.a: Yes. The price in the editor updates so shoppers see the total before checkout.

faqs.q: Do I have to adjust prices by hand?
faqs.a: No. Prices adjust automatically based on what the shopper adds to their design.
